patterns.name: Dual-Pattern Regex for Production HTML Variations
patterns.issue_description: HTML structure varies between development and production environments (e.g., production uses <span> tags, legacy uses plain text). Single regex pattern fails to match all variations.
symptoms: Transformation works in development but fails in production
Some HTML elements removed, others remain
Test cases pass but production HTML not transformed
root_causes: Production HTML uses different tag structure than development
Legacy data exists alongside new formats
Third-party HTML integration with inconsistent markup
patterns.solution: Implement multiple regex patterns targeting each HTML variation. Apply patterns sequentially (most specific → most general). Test against all known HTML variations (dev, staging, production, legacy). Log metrics for each pattern to verify coverage.
patterns.prevention: Collect HTML samples from all environments before implementing transformations. Create comprehensive test suite with all variations. Document expected HTML structures in code comments. Log pattern match metrics in production.
learned_from: hcp (hadees token removal, plain text button removal)
